brief:
# Build: claude-settings (Urgent profile)

Brett, Nov 3 2026 (voice): "I need a plugin called Claude. Claude settings. A setting to enable your no-wait in that. A whole bunch of settings that are for Claude, that you check on axHub and then act accordingly." Assigned agent: **Janitor Joey** (book on his card; AXF_AGENT=janitor-joey if supported). Register in Urgent (id `claude-settings`) + banner entry.

## Plugin
Console plugin **Claude** (plugin@1, lifecycle install/uninstall, page + Settings > Plugins > Claude, context-menu hook 'Claude settings' everywhere). Settings are stored on axHub (shared `_data/claude/settings.json` or a hub settings namespace) so every Claude session (voice, chat, Claude Code, headless agents) reads the same values.

## Settings (grouped, framework settings renderer with the level toolbar)
- **No wait** (owner-only): when ON, Amber's held calls run immediately instead of the 90 s veto / approval. Implement as a standing axHub pass that the console creates on Brett's signed-in click (reuse pass-all / `axhub.pass_grant` machinery, scope all, `include_irreversible` false by default with its own separate switch 'Include irreversible' also owner-only). Options: duration (1 h / 4 h / until I turn it off), auto-off at night. Banner chip while on. Turning it off revokes the pass instantly.
- **Follow Amber** (link to / share state with the follow-amber build's switch; don't duplicate it - read the same setting).
- **Builds:** default model (Opus/Fable/split), launch builds without asking (on/off), max parallel builds, per-build budget cap and daily budget cap (stop + notify when hit), always assign a named agent (locked on), UI Review gate (on).
- **Verification:** trust live store by default, verify only on conflict (current rule) vs always verify.
- **Talking:** persona on/off, tone level, address terms, swearing level, response length (short/normal/detailed), say costs out loud, read build reports aloud vs summary.
- **Notifications:** push on build done / blocked / approval waiting, quiet hours.
- **Memory/notes:** save session notes to Notes Vault automatically, handoff note at end of session.
- Open registry so new Claude settings can be added as data without code changes.

## Claude reads them
- MCP tools via axf-console (and axHub builtin if simpler): `claude_settings_get` (policy ALLOW, read-only) returning all values with plain descriptions; `claude_settings_set` for NON-owner settings only (veto policy). Owner-only settings (No wait, Include irreversible, approvals, budget caps raising) can ONLY be changed by Brett's signed-in console click - agents/sessions can never change them (test enforces).
- Rule in shared RULES.md + CLAUDE.md (top): 'At session start and before acting, read Claude settings (claude_settings_get) and follow them.'
- Commands declared once -> REST + MCP + CLI.

## Done
Tests (owner-only enforcement, pass created/revoked by the switch, read tool), phone + desktop screenshots, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/claude-settings.md`, THREADS, PR, steps through the store. Commits clean and professional.

open: Follow Amber: the follow-amber build (running in another session, Urgent) has no switch on main yet. This plugin owns the shared key `followAmber.enabled`; follow-amber should read it (`claude_settings_get` / `axf.claude-settings@1`) instead of adding its own.

Acting on the settings is up to each session (the rule says read and follow). Nothing yet enforces the budget caps or max parallel automatically in the launcher/orchestrator; that would be a follow-up build wiring `deploy/claude-headless.sh` and agent-slots to these values.
axHub policy: `claude_settings_get` is annotated read-only (axHub's default runs reads without a veto) and `claude_settings_set` is a write (veto). No axHub-side change was made.
Direct file writes to the hub document (a shell on the VPS) bypass the transports; the No wait power itself still needs a pass, which only Brett's session or his signed axHub approval creates.
Shared `RULES.md` is held by claude-sync (changed on both sides); the repo copy has the new rule. Brett picks which copy to keep (`claude-sync resolve shared:rules/RULES.md --keep local|hub`).
